description: This file defines the IntOrFloat class, which provides a utility method to evaluate a value and return it as an integer if possible, or as a float otherwise. It is used within the PhpSpreadsheet library to handle large result values properly in different environments.

classes.name: IntOrFloat
classes.description: A utility class providing static method to evaluate a numeric value and return it as an integer if it equals its integer casting, or as float otherwise.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the input value and returns it as an integer if it equals its integer cast, or as a float otherwise.
